findings.issue: The only framework-docs consultation (mcp nextjs_docs) failed because Next wasn't installed yet and was never retried after scaffolding; Next 16 idioms (async params, force-dynamic) were trusted from memory.
findings.suggestion: Re-query the bundled Next docs after `npm install` when the first attempt fails, at least for the few APIs the whole app hinges on (params, dynamic rendering, not-found handling).

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'next start'` matched the agent's own bash command line and killed the shell (exit 143).
findings.suggestion: List PIDs with `ps` first and `kill` specific PIDs, or use a pattern that can't match the invoking command.

findings.issue: A multi-hunk CSS edit accidentally removed the adjacent `.pokemon-card-link` mobile rule, requiring an immediate repair edit.
findings.suggestion: Keep hunks to one contiguous block, or re-read the affected region right after a large edit before moving on.

findings.issue: Two image reads failed on paths that don't exist (artifacts/missing.png, then a wrong screenshot filename) — small avoidable waste.
findings.suggestion: List the directory or copy the exact path from the prior tool result before reading.

findings.issue: First edit in a 3-hunk cleanup was a no-op (oldText identical to newText).
findings.suggestion: Drop no-op hunks; they add a tool call and noise for no change.

summary: A disciplined, plan-first session: full spec/test/data/screenshot read-in, near-first-try implementation, one cause-level fix cycle, and then genuine post-test verification including pixel-accurate comparison against the reference designs that caught and fixed real mismatches. Waste is limited to a few avoidable tool slips (failed docs call never retried, a self-killing pkill, a too-broad CSS edit) that never cost more than a turn each.
